problems.quote: the current changes direction 50 or 60 times per second
problems.problem: AC frequency of 50/60 Hz means the current changes direction twice per cycle, i.e., 100/120 times per second.
problems.correction: the current alternates at 50 or 60 Hz (changes direction 100 or 120 times per second)
problems.verifierReason: Original confuses frequency (cycles/sec) with zero-crossings. 50/60 Hz = 100/120 direction changes/sec. Correction is precise.

problems.problem: Radioactive decay does not power nuclear reactors; nuclear fission does.
problems.verifierReason: Standard power reactors rely on induced fission chain reactions, not spontaneous radioactive decay; correction is precise.

problems.problem: Missing π and ε₀ in Coulomb's constant formula; missing multiplication sign in 9×10⁹.
problems.verifierReason: Original missing π, ε₀, and multiplication sign; correction is standard Coulomb constant formula.

problems.problem: Missing ε₀ in denominator of Gauss's law.
problems.verifierReason: Original has zero denominator and missing dot product; correction gives correct Gauss's law.

problems.problem: Missing ε₀ in parallel-plate capacitance formula.
problems.verifierReason: Original uses zero instead of ε₀; correction gives correct parallel-plate capacitance formula.
